questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is an antibody?
A. Something that guides macrophages to pathogens
B. A protein produced by the immune system
C. A blood cell that transports oxygen
Answer: B. Antibody is produced to neutralize pathogens like bacteria and viruses and some can also facilitate macrophages, a type of white blood cell that can kill microorganisms.
questions.de: Was für ein Molekül ist ein Antikörper, den das Immunsystem bildet, um Krankheitserreger wie Bakterien und Viren unschädlich zu machen?
questions.en: What kind of molecule is an antibody, which the immune system produces to neutralize pathogens such as bacteria and viruses?

timeline.labelEn: Emil von Behring and Kitasato Shibasaburō describe antibody activity against diphtheria and tetanus toxins
timeline.labelDe: Emil von Behring und Kitasato Shibasaburō beschreiben die Wirkung von Antikörpern gegen Diphtherie- und Tetanustoxine

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] What metal is the best conductor of electricity?
A. Silver B. Gold C. Copper
Answer: A. Silver is the best metal conductor of electricity, but due to its cost and tendency to tarnish, copper (for general wiring) and gold (in high-reliability applications) are more commonly used in electrical applications.
questions.de: Welches Metall leitet Elektrizität am besten, obwohl wegen seines Preises und seiner Neigung anzulaufen meist Kupfer und Gold in der Elektrotechnik verwendet werden?
questions.en: Which metal is the best conductor of electricity, though copper and gold are more commonly used in wiring because of its cost and tendency to tarnish?

timeline.labelEn: Silver is already being separated from lead in Asia Minor and the Aegean (4th millennium BC)
timeline.labelDe: Silber wird in Kleinasien und in der Ägäis bereits aus Blei gewonnen (4. Jahrtausend v. Chr.)

questions.notes: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity of any metal (Wikipedia: Silver); copper is only marginally worse.
